AI Animations skill initial release:

- Instantly turn product logos and brand visuals into 1080p animated video clips from images or text prompts.
- Simple workflow: upload, describe desired animation, receive video in 1–2 minutes — no manual editing or export settings.
- Seamless connection to backend; handles authentication, session management, and free credit allocation.
- Exports in multiple formats (mp4, mov, gif, etc.), with built-in credit management and error handling.
- Guided prompt-to-action routing for tasks like uploading, exporting, or checking status.
- Streamlines cloud-based video rendering and delivers persistent session editing for ongoing projects.
